name: Moroccan Chickpea, Apricot, Bell Pepper & Zucchini Curry with Couscous

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message:
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ cups whole wheat couscous

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
3 red bell peppers
3 medium zucchini squash
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds. Place in a large bowl.
Trim, seed, and thinly slice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the carrot.
Peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies start to soften, 6-7 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp chili powder
1 ½ tbsp garam masala
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp cinnamon, ground
¼ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Place in the reserved bowl.
Roughly chop apricots and add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Drain and rinse chickpeas in a colander.
Once the veggies start to soften, add zucchini, apricots, chickpeas, tomatoes, broth, tomato paste, and sugar to the pot. Stir to combine the curry and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
6 tbsp tomato paste
2 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies and chickpeas are tender, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the curry is done, remove from heat, add half of the parsley, and stir to combine. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
To serve, divide couscous and curry between plates or bowls. Top with reserved parsley and pine nuts. Enjoy!
